source_table.time_column_rule: A printed Time value belongs to the direct value printed on the same row. In the midway section that value is Divisions; in the negative and positive sections it is Extreme points.
source_table.point_of_rest_rule: Point of rest is a printed table calculation associated with neighbouring extrema. It is not an instantaneous telescope reading and does not acquire the row clock as its own observation time.
source_table.missed_row_rule: Rows printed as missed contain no observation value and are not interpolated into historical records.

clock_axis.rollover_rule: The 12-hour table continues forward through noon. Values 0:05, 0:12 and 0:19 after 11:51 are normalized to 12:05, 12:12 and 12:19 while preserving the original print string.

transition_intervals.display_rule: The weights were moved after the last midway reading and before the first negative-position extreme. No exact movement time is printed.
The weights were moved after the last negative-position extreme and before the first positive-position extreme. No exact movement time is printed.

wave_display.guide: Connect direct timed values only within the same confirmed mass-position section.
wave_display.transition_rule: Do not connect the waveform across a transition-time uncertainty interval.
wave_display.reconstruction: No quarter-period time shift and no Experiment I physical model are applied.
